expectations.text: Migration SQL enables RLS on bir_deadlines table
expectations.evidence: 002_add_bir_deadlines.sql line 31: ALTER TABLE bir_deadlines ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; followed by three RLS policies

expectations.text: RLS policies scope to auth.uid() = user_id
expectations.evidence: Lines 34-47: Three RLS policies (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE) all use USING (auth.uid() = user_id) or WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id)

expectations.text: Table includes deleted_at column and soft-delete pattern
expectations.evidence: 002_add_bir_deadlines.sql line 18: deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ column present. RLS policies filter: WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

expectations.text: API route includes auth check and user-scoped query
expectations.evidence: route.ts lines 10-20: getUser() auth check. Lines 24-29: query filters .eq('user_id', user.id).is('deleted_at', null)

expectations.text: DeadlineCard uses conditional color: amber/honey for 7-day warning, red for 3-day urgent
expectations.evidence: deadline-card.tsx lines 32-37: daysRemaining <= 3 sets red colors, daysRemaining <= 7 sets amber colors
page.tsx line 33: 'Walang BIR deadlines para sa iyo ngayon. Relax, ika'y updated!'

expectations.text: Page is a Server Component, DeadlineCard is appropriately split
expectations.evidence: page.tsx has no 'use client' directive, uses async getUser() and server-side query. deadline-card.tsx has 'use client' for interactivity

expectations.text: Mobile-first responsive design (base styles for mobile, sm:/md: for larger)
